rooms.description: A broad band of storm-grey windows backlights the low navigation consoles and radio handset. The sea tilts across the panes, a blue radar circle glows below, and a clipped log lies open at one end.
rooms.feeling: Watchful, with the gale in full view.

rooms.description: From just above the stippled floor, teal hoses loop down through steel bench legs to squat pumps. Ceiling strips catch droplets on the tall sampling manifold, with capped bottles clustered in a rack beneath it.
rooms.feeling: Humid and loud, with the pumps running steadily.

rooms.description: At seated height, a square grid of monitors fills the far wall, their violet plots lighting the edge of a straight black desk. A single keyboard sits between two squared stacks of pencilled graphs.
rooms.feeling: Cool, hushed and absorbed in the data.

rooms.description: Look down onto a round table bolted to the deck, ringed with mismatched mugs and a crumpled napkin. A frosted ceiling fixture warms the orange tabletop, with a coffee urn and squat refrigerator beyond.
rooms.feeling: Familiar and warm, as if someone has just stepped away.

rooms.description: From the far corner, a pale green examination bed cuts diagonally across the room. A swing-arm light pools on its paper cover, leaving flush cabinet latches and a compact diagnostic monitor in light grey wash.
rooms.feeling: Clean, quiet and ready for whoever comes through the door.

rooms.description: Stand in the threshold and look down a short passage, with four narrow cabin doors on each side. Warm yellow light from the ajar door at the end outlines the handrails and a pair of slippers.
rooms.feeling: Private and still, with someone awake at the far end.

rooms.description: Peer past the shoulder of an empty swivel chair toward a desk set at a slant to the view. A low lamp catches red headphones, camera bodies, charging leads and pinned strips of thumbnail sketches.
rooms.feeling: Intimate, with work still in progress.

rooms.description: From a back corner, a long bench splits the frame, with a yellow vise projecting into the aisle. A caged work light throws hard shadows from spanners, ribbed spare housings and the raised maintenance terminal.
rooms.feeling: Loud and practical, with vibration coming up through the deck.

people.description: Broad shoulders taper sharply into a fitted charcoal blazer as he leans back. He has a narrow chin, a practiced smile and slick silver hair. One hand opens beside a plum pocket square, eyes meeting yours.
people.feeling: Personable and eager to get to the point.

people.description: Tall and straight, she clasps her hands behind a navy uniform jacket, elbows barely clear of her outline. Window light rims a close grey crop and high cheekbones as she looks past your shoulder.
people.feeling: Measured and attentive to what is happening beyond the conversation.

people.description: Seated, she cups a mug inside the rounded outline of a quilted vest and teal fleece. A dark bob curves around her round face, and monitor glow catches her tired eyes as she looks up.
people.feeling: Tired, attentive and glad to help.

people.description: Stocky and square through the shoulders, he hunches in orange coveralls, wiping grease from his knuckles with a rag. Hard light catches clipped black curls, a broad nose and the stubble along his lowered jaw.
people.feeling: Worn out, with his attention still on the job.

people.description: Narrow shoulders widen into a loose sage scrub top at the hips. She stands half-turned with hands folded low, a short auburn braid resting against her collar, and glances sideways into the lamp's pool.
people.feeling: Quietly attentive, giving you time to finish.

people.description: Lanky and pitched forward, he lifts two fingers to one earcup, its red cable tracing his close-fitting jacket. Soft light catches unruly blond curls, a pointed chin and a quick grin aimed across the room.
people.feeling: Restless and ready to strike up a conversation.
